name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: (8b) The association should aim to facilitate the OCTs’ participation in international ocean governance instruments and bodies, the implementation of the European Ocean Pact, and the OCTs’ participation in the implementation of the Agreement under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity of Areas beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ). Support to ocean governance should not be limited to geopolitical or security aspects but also take into account the environmental, economic, cultural, social and territorial dimensions of the oceans, and the traditional rights and knowledge of indigenous peoples and local communities. The subsistence and cultural practices of indigenous peoples and communities should be safeguarded and their contribution to conservation and climate resilience should be promoted.
